diagnostics.message: google_project_iam_member.oslogin_admins grants roles/compute.osAdminLogin, which GCP rejects unless OS Login is already enabled on the project. The resource that enables it (google_compute_project_metadata_item.oslogin_meta, key "enable-oslogin") has no ordering relationship with this member: no attribute reference and no depends_on. When var.oslogin is true, Terraform may apply the role grant before the metadata item is created and the Compute Engine API will fail the grant.
